entries.reason: Storage integrations are deferred with search providers; this reference build returns the ordinary 404.
TMDB access is an external integration; this reference build returns the ordinary 404.
Raw and GStreamer playback remain separate implementations and contracts; the no-play probe is wire-equivalent.
ffprobe is not required for raw playback and is absent from this reference build.
MCP is deferred past the first version (user decision 2026-09-23): an AI-agent client over the API Rustorr already serves; existing players do not use it.
Virtual filesystem surfaces are deferred and absent from this reference build.
DLNA and Bonjour discovery are deferred and the HTTP probe is absent from this reference build.
Service and install control routes are outside R6; POST is absent from this reference build.
The reference's bundled web UI is intentionally not carried over (user decision 2026-09-23); R8 ships a new interface.
MatriX.145 prints anacrolix's internal client dump; Rustorr prints the same per-torrent facts in its own format. No client parses this diagnostic page.
The reference serves TorrServer's own artwork; Rustorr ships its own 48x48 PNG icon under the same path and type.
The reference serves TorrServer's own artwork; Rustorr ships its own 120x120 PNG icon under the same path and type.
Without ffmpegthumbnailer dms falls back to device icon 0, which is Rustorr's own artwork.
The default DLNA name embeds the process user's full name: the reference container runs as root, Rustorr as the unprivileged rustorr user without one. The naming rules are unit-tested.
